name: Week 10 - APT29 vs Physical Insider
description: Score = how many of the 3 actors use the technique (APT29, DPRK IT workers, physical insider).

techniques.comment: Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: Reuse of stolen credentials and tokens. Insider: Insider uses own legitimate account. Logs: SIEM sign-in logs; badge logs
Used by: APT29. APT29: SolarWinds Orion update trojanized with SUNBURST (2020). Insider: Developer inserts code into internal build pipeline. Logs: GitHub audit logs; CI/CD logs
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers. APT29: Abuse of IT resellers / cloud service providers. Insider: Contractor or fake remote hire gets access via HR onboarding. Logs: HR onboarding records; IdP logs
Used by: DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: nan. Insider: Rogue USB / KVM-over-IP device plugged into a corporate laptop. Logs: EDR device-connect events
Used by: APT29. APT29: Signed .rdp files sent to 100+ orgs (Oct 2024); wine-tasting lures (2025). Insider: n/a - insider already inside. Logs: Email gateway logs
Used by: APT29. APT29: Spraying a legacy test tenant before Microsoft breach (2024). Insider: nan. Logs: IdP failed sign-ins
Used by: APT29. APT29: MFA fatigue pushes to targets. Insider: Insider asks colleague to approve push 'for a test'. Logs: IdP MFA logs
Used by: APT29, Physical insider. APT29: Granting mailbox access to attacker-controlled app. Insider: Insider grants himself access to manager's mailbox. Logs: M365 audit log
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: Registering attacker device in Entra ID. Insider: Insider enrolls personal device to keep access after leaving. Logs: IdP device audit
Used by: APT29, Physical insider. APT29: New users created through Azure AD. Insider: Admin-insider creates backdoor account before resignation. Logs: IdP audit log
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: Malware named like Orion components. Insider: Fake identity / stolen US identity used for hiring. Logs: EDR; HR verification
Used by: APT29, Physical insider. APT29: Removing tools after use. Insider: Insider deletes local copies and browser history. Logs: EDR file events
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers. APT29: Residential proxies to hide origin. Insider: VPN / laptop farm hides real location of remote worker. Logs: VPN and proxy logs
Used by: DPRK IT workers. APT29: nan. Insider: AnyDesk / KVM tools on laptop hosted in a laptop farm. Logs: EDR process events; proxy logs
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: Collecting files from compromised hosts. Insider: Copying files from own workstation. Logs: EDR file events
Used by: DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: nan. Insider: Phone photo of screen / screenshots of sensitive docs. Logs: DLP; EDR
Used by: APT29, Physical insider. APT29: Reading leadership mailboxes at Microsoft (2024). Insider: Insider reads shared mailboxes. Logs: M365 audit log
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: Bulk download from SharePoint/Teams. Insider: Insider bulk-downloads project folders before resignation. Logs: M365 / SharePoint audit
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: 7-Zip password-protected archives of emails. Insider: Insider zips data before copying to USB. Logs: EDR process events
Used by: APT29. APT29: Exfil over non-standard channels. Insider: nan. Logs: Firewall / NetFlow
Used by: Physical insider. APT29: nan. Insider: Copying archives to personal USB stick. Logs: EDR removable-media events
Used by: APT29, DPRK IT workers, Physical insider. APT29: Uploading to cloud services. Insider: Upload to personal Google Drive / Dropbox. Logs: Proxy / CASB logs
Used by: DPRK IT workers. APT29: nan. Insider: DPRK workers extort employers with stolen code (FBI PSA 2025). Logs: Incident reports
